description.value: The Guesthouse at Crowsnest Vineyards is a family-run 3-star, 7-room bed and breakfast set among the vineyards and orchards of the Similkameen Valley, right on the Crowsnest Highway #3 just south of Cawston. A continental breakfast of fruits, breads, charcuterie, and coffee is included with each stay, and guests have access to an on-site restaurant, winery, tasting bar, and bakery. The rural vineyard setting and views from above the orchard make it a distinctive and self-contained stop for anyone cycling the Similkameen.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website guesthouse page confirms 7 smoke-free rooms with private bathrooms and free in-room Wi-Fi, corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan tag. The on-site restaurant with dinner service is confirmed across multiple subpages. Neither the website nor OSM mentions secure bike storage, a bike room, or any staff bike-handling procedure, so both required criteria remain null. The contact page confirms the phone number and provides the full address including city and postal code, with a minor street suffix discrepancy (Drive vs Rd) between OSM and the website.
concerns: OSM lists the street as 'Surprise Drive' but the website contact page shows '2035 Surprise Rd' — minor street suffix discrepancy; contact_confirmed.address set to false.
No mention of secure bike storage or bike handling anywhere on the website; both required WWC criteria are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a real, operational accommodation on a major cycling route (Crowsnest Highway #3) and would be genuinely useful to touring cyclists, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike procedure could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags — both required WWC criteria are unverified and require direct contact with the property.
enrichment_extras.notes: RV parking is noted on the contact page. The property is wheelchair accessible (tasting bar, restaurant, patio, and washroom), with a designated accessible parking space.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site restaurant serving lunch and dinner; open seasonally with full dinner service

wow_evidence: right on the Crowsnest Highway #3... continental breakfast... winery, tasting bar, and bakery
